digest.component_or_area: LLM failure reporting and operator messaging
propositions: When an LLM call is blocked by a content policy (Bedrock Guardrail or Anthropic refusal), the operator-facing message incorrectly states 'too large / malformed' rather than naming the actual cause (content policy block).
The resolution_class CHANGE_INPUT is correct for content-filter blocks and must not be reclassified, as it is shared with genuine size/malformed cases (HTTP 413, context-length 400).

The message_for() function must accept an optional finish_reason parameter and return a content-policy-specific message when finish_reason='content_filter' and resolution_class=CHANGE_INPUT, while preserving backward compatibility and the existing generic message for other cases.
The finish_reason field is already available in LLMOutcome.diagnostic and persisted coverage diagnostic, so it can be threaded through all three render call sites without additional data collection.
